主要内容: KENTUCKY BANCSHARES, INC. announced in its Form 8-K filing dated January 23, 2013, that it expects to mail its quarterly financial information for the fourth quarter of 2012 to its shareholders on or about January 30, 2013. A copy of this mailing is attached as Exhibit 99.1. The filing includes a release dated January 23, 2013, containing the quarterly financial information as of December 31, 2012. The company's Chief Financial Officer, Gregory J. Dawson, signed the report on behalf of the registrant.
